fact: Zimbabwe's Minister of ICT said in an official LinkedIn post that the government is implementing a Government Service Bus and online portal for once-only data sharing across all ministries, with no statement that it is live.

DHIS2.org says Zimbabwe's Ministry of Health and Child Care is linking its case-based surveillance system to the national health information system, with the OpenHIM mediator carrying data between the ICD-11 service and DHIS2 Tracker; the solution was in final testing in June 2026 with go-live expected by end July 2026.
